def evaluate(W, B,
             _TW=TW, _TB=TB, _NA=NOT_A, _NH=NOT_H,
             _GE=GE, _LE=LE, _pc=popcount):
    s = (_TW[0][W & 255] - _TB[0][B & 255]
         + _TW[1][(W >> 8) & 255] - _TB[1][(B >> 8) & 255]
         + _TW[2][(W >> 16) & 255] - _TB[2][(B >> 16) & 255]
         + _TW[3][(W >> 24) & 255] - _TB[3][(B >> 24) & 255]
         + _TW[4][(W >> 32) & 255] - _TB[4][(B >> 32) & 255]
         + _TW[5][(W >> 40) & 255] - _TB[5][(B >> 40) & 255]
         + _TW[6][(W >> 48) & 255] - _TB[6][(B >> 48) & 255]
         + _TW[7][(W >> 56) & 255] - _TB[7][(B >> 56) & 255])
    e = ~(W | B)
    aw = ((W & _NA) << 7) | ((W & _NH) << 9)
    ab = ((B & _NA) >> 9) | ((B & _NH) >> 7)
    s += 3 * (_pc((W << 8) & e) + _pc(aw & ~W)
              - _pc((B >> 8) & e) - _pc(ab & ~B))
    if B:
        pw = W & _GE[(B.bit_length() - 1) >> 3]
        if pw:
            s += 160 * _pc(pw)
    if W:
        pb = B & _LE[((W & -W).bit_length() - 1) >> 3]
        if pb:
            s -= 160 * _pc(pb)
    return s

def find_win_move(S, O, white, _NA=NOT_A, _NH=NOT_H, _GW=GOALW, _GB=GOALB):
    e = ~(S | O)
    ns = ~S
    if white:
        push = (S << 8) & e
        dL = ((S & _NA) << 7) & ns
        dR = ((S & _NH) << 9) & ns
        w = (push | dL | dR) & _GW
        if w:
            d = w & -w
            di = d.bit_length() - 1
            if d & push:
                si = (d >> 8).bit_length() - 1
            elif d & dL:
                si = (d >> 7).bit_length() - 1
            else:
                si = (d >> 9).bit_length() - 1
            return (si << 6) | di
    else:
        push = (S >> 8) & e
        dL = ((S & _NA) >> 9) & ns
        dR = ((S & _NH) >> 7) & ns
        w = (push | dL | dR) & _GB
        if w:

            di = d.bit_length() - 1
            if d & push:
                si = (d << 8).bit_length() - 1
            elif d & dL:
                si = (d << 9).bit_length() - 1
            else:
                si = (d << 7).bit_length() - 1
            return (si << 6) | di
    return 0
